page.about.title: Bader Humanitarian: independent work from Gaza
page.about.intro: An independent Palestinian non-profit humanitarian organization founded in Gaza in 2023 to support families in need and strengthen Palestinian resilience.
page.about.about.mission.title: Our mission
page.about.about.mission.text: Provide integrated humanitarian support that protects dignity and responds to essential needs.
page.about.about.work.title: Our work
page.about.about.work.text: We focus on Palestine and the Gaza Strip, serving families in need, affected families, women, and children.
page.about.about.independence.title: Our independence
page.about.about.independence.text: Bader is an independent humanitarian organization with no political alignment, guided by solidarity and partnership.
page.programs.title: Relief and development fields
page.programs.intro: From water and food to education and empowerment, Bader combines urgent response with sustainable work.
page.campaigns.title: Giving opportunities with impact
page.campaigns.intro: We show known campaigns and published information, while financial progress remains limited to approved figures.

page.impact.intro: We do not publish beneficiary numbers or completion rates until they are approved and reviewed.
page.impact.impact.verification.title: Approved figures only
page.impact.impact.verification.text: Financial figures and beneficiary counts require approval before publication.
page.impact.impact.operations.title: Impact through operations
page.impact.impact.operations.text: The desalination plant, bakery, school, and relief projects represent ongoing work.
page.impact.impact.reporting.title: Responsible updates
page.impact.impact.reporting.text: Impact data is updated when a clear institutional source is available, without estimates.
page.news.title: Bader news and stories

page.partners.partners.international.tex: Institutional cooperation that supports humanitarian response and sustainable work.

page.faq.title: Clear answers about Bader
page.faq.intro: Key published information about the association's identity, work, and area of operation.
faq.identity.question: What is Bader Humanitarian Association?
faq.identity.answer: An independent Palestinian non-profit humanitarian organization founded in Gaza in 2023.
faq.politics.question: Does the association have a political alignment?
faq.politics.answer: No. The association is an independent humanitarian organization with no political alignment.
faq.location.question: Where does Bader work?
faq.location.answer: The association focuses on Palestine and the Gaza Strip, with a published contact presence in Muscat.
faq.work.question: What are the main fields of work?
faq.work.answer: Water, food, shelter, winter support, health, education, protection, empowerment, partnerships, zakat, and sacrifices.
faq.long_term.question: How does Bader support families' future?
faq.long_term.answer: By combining urgent relief with education, protection, small-project support, and empowerment.
